cite: SRD 5.2.1, Fighter Core Traits; Fighting Style; Fighter Subclass; Ability Score Improvement
note: Core Traits table: "Armor Training: Light, Medium, and Heavy armor and Shields"; "Weapon Proficiencies: Simple and Martial weapons"; "Skill Proficiencies: Choose 2: Acrobatics, Animal Handling, Athletics, History, Insight, Intimidation, Persuasion, Perception, or Survival". @1/weapon-masteries is a literal:'text' placeholder (R6) — selecting which weapon-mastery properties a character knows needs an item-tag query EntityQuerySchema can't express yet; Phase 4 structures it. @4/feat matches the Ability Score Improvement feature's text: "You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat ... or another feat of your choice for which you qualify."

SRD text: "You can use this feature twice. You regain one expended use when you finish a Short Rest, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest." Our reset vocabulary only expresses "resets to max on trigger", not "regain one use" — reset: 'shortRest' is a vocabulary approximation of the short-rest partial recharge. max: '2' is the level-1 value; the level-scaled use count (2 at levels 1-3, 3 at levels 4+) is already carried verbatim by transformClasses() in the upstream row extra 'fighter-second-wind-uses', left untouched by this overlay.

SRD text: "Once you use this feature, you can't do so again until you finish a Short or Long Rest. Starting at level 17, you can use it twice before a rest but only once on a turn." The level-17 second use is out of this task's level 1-5 scope.

effects.name: Action Surge
effects.description: Take one additional action on your turn, other than the Magic action.

note: SRD text: "You can attack twice instead of once whenever you take the Attack action on your turn."

SRD text: "...allows you to use the mastery properties of three kinds of Simple or Martial weapons of your choice." count: '3' is the level-1 value; the level-scaled count (3 at levels 1-3, 4 at levels 4+) is already carried verbatim by transformClasses() in the upstream row extra 'fighter-weapon-mastery-count', left untouched by this overlay.

SRD text: "Your attack rolls with weapons and Unarmed Strikes can score a Critical Hit on a roll of 19 or 20 on the d20." Recorded as a tag for 1a's text-level scope; the crit-range mechanic itself is Phase-4/1b vocabulary.
